Name: Medad
Summary: Medad was one of the seventy elders on whom the Spirit rested in the wilderness; though he stayed in the camp, he prophesied there.
KeyStory: When the Spirit fell on the elders, Medad prophesied in the camp, and Moses refused to stop him, wishing all the LORD's people were prophets.
LifeLesson: The gift is God's to give, not ours to gatekeep.
